replace: .cockpit-left { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--outline-primary); overflow: hidden; }
breaks: Adds overflow:hidden to the fixed 220px-tall left panel only inside the max-width:800px media query, clipping device/telemetry content below the fold with no way to scroll to it.
briefLine: Works in modern browsers on phones, tablets, laptops and desktops
expectedImpact: On a phone the lower telemetry rows and device entries are cut off and unreachable because the panel can no longer scroll.
